plan.title: Add Surrogate Bid to eRFX Auction

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants view, as required for an existing prepared event.
Enable surrogate bids after an existing bid as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects for the tenant.
Submit the buyer's bid on behalf of Vendor A.
Verify that the surrogate bid submission was accepted.
Verify the buyer-side responses view marks at least one response as a surrogate bid.
Open the comparison grid to inspect ranking after the surrogate bid.
Verify that the bid is ranked in Master QCS.
